text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD:RDW-HOSTED-500): 90% p99 latency > 4s across prod-west. https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PA12345
incident-bot: Escalation policy 'prod-critical' triggered. Primary on-call (mia) has 2m to ack before automatic escalation.
mia (oncall): seeing spiking 5xx and latency in dashboards. investigating. pinging DB/infra runbooks.
raj (eng-oncall): onphone, can grab crash logs and flamegraphs if needed.
mia (oncall): tried to ack via mobile, phone in DND. didn't register. :phone: no ack.
pagerduty-bot: No ACK received. Escalating to secondary in 2m.
elaine (support): customer-reported errors in EU region; ticket #1234 showing 503s for embed endpoint.
sam (sre-manager): I'm awake, pinged via PD manager override. I'll manually reroute to senior oncall if primary is unreachable.
incident-bot: Manager override requested by @sam. Auto-escalation paused while manager intervenes.
sam (sre-manager): rerouting now to raj (eng-oncall) and owen. command run:
```
# manager override: route alert to user
pd reroute --alert PA12345 --add-user raj --add-user owen --reason \"primary DND; manager override\"
```
now bridging on Zoom: https://zoom.example/meet/incident-3278912345
owen (eng): joining. pulling service logs, tailing nginx and inference runtime logs.
raj (eng-oncall): tailing /var/log/redwood/inference.log - showing repeated 502 from model-host-12.
now
```
[2026-03-15T03:21:45Z] model-host-12 502 connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T03:21:46Z] backend pool exhausted, retrying
```
mia (oncall): ack via web UI finally. sorry — DND misconfigured on my phone.
mia (oncall): reverting mobile DND to allow PD pages. :thumbsup:
sam (sre-manager): good. who has write access to routing? we should reduce traffic to host12 and failover.
owen (eng): adding temporary traffic split:
```
kubectl patch svc inference --patch '{"spec":{"traffic":{"split":"0.2:host-12,0.8:host-NN"}}}'
```
elaine (support): PR sent to affected customers explaining degraded embeddings; ETA 30m for full recovery.
raj (eng-oncall): mitigation in place, retries reduced, latency p99 falling from 4.6s -> 1.2s.
sam (sre-manager): excellent. keep PD alert open until confirmed stable.
incident-bot: Alert status: acknowledged by mia, raj, owen. Escalation paused.
owen (eng): note for postmortem: mobile DND causing missed primary ack -> manager override. include steps to detect mobile unreachable earlier.
mia (oncall): filing short blameless note.
sam (sre-manager): after action: add an extra SMS contact for primary, and a \"auto-override if no mobile ack within 90s\" option in policy.
elaine (support): closing customer ticket with mitigation notes in 45m.
raj (eng-oncall): will keep monitoring for next 2 hours. ping me if any regression.
sam (sre-manager): thanks team :tada:
